## ⚡ Improved

- **Euro Office looks after its own `Data` folder.** The upstream image checks on every start that `Data` belongs to the user its services run as, and fixes it if not ([Euro-Office/DocumentServer#335](https://github.com/Euro-Office/DocumentServer/issues/335)). The extra program this image carried for that from the first release is gone. Your documents and settings stay where they are. The problem was first reported in [unraid-apps#7](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/unraid-apps/issues/7).
- The start banner appears in the container log right before Euro Office starts, not about 30 seconds in.
- The build test mounts `Data` from an outside folder, as Unraid does, and fails if Euro Office stops taking that folder over.

## Updating an existing install

Nothing to change, **Force Update** is enough.
